verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. Connecting Claude Code or Codex means using Munito as a model backend through OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible APIs, which is a different capability from exposing tools via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
